targetText: The patriarchal form of the family... was not only assumed without question to be the oldest form, but it was also identified... with the bourgeois family of today, so that the family had really experienced no historical development at all
summary: 19th-century scholars falsely assumed that the modern patriarchal family had existed unchanged throughout human history, treating temporary capitalist marriage norms as eternal human nature.
context: Engels critiques bourgeois ideology for projecting modern capitalist family structures backward into prehistory. In reality, human family systems evolved dramatically across different economic stages.
